component.name: Awakened PoE Trade Native
component.summary: Native Linux Path of Exile trade overlay

description.p: A native Qt and KDE host for the Awakened PoE Trade interface, with Wayland overlays, global shortcuts, tray integration, trade lookup, clipboard actions, game-log tracking, Heist OCR, and native updates.

developer.name: Awakened PoE Trade and Native Contributors

description.p: Restores complete modifier parsing and native numeric filter entry, fixes tray shutdown and external-window behavior, and improves system-browser activation on Wayland.
Hardens native releases with pinned inputs, provenance and SBOM attestations, expands Wayland backend tests, and adds native documentation plus automatic upstream monitoring.
